source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Group 2 compounds in medicine (PDF 14).

items: Magnesium hydroxide ('milk of magnesia') maide ka zaid tezaab khatam karta aur halka julaab hai; kam hall pazeeri ise mehfooz banati hai. Calcium carbonate bhi bad-hazmi ki goliyon mein antacid ke taur par use hota hai.
Calcium compounds (calcium carbonate, calcium citrate waghaira) mazboot haddiyon aur daanton ke liye zaroori aur osteoporosis se bachao ke supplements ke taur par aam hain.
Magnesium compounds (magnesium sulphate, magnesium citrate waghaira) muscles aur asaab ke kaam ke liye ahem aur magnesium ki kami ka ilaaj hain; Epsom salts julaab aur nahane mein use hote hain.

Barium sulphate nizam-e-hazma ki X-ray tasweer ke 'barium meals' mein use hota hai: X-rays is mein se nahi guzarti aur yeh itna kam ghulta hai ke jazb hue baghair jism se guzar jata hai, is liye mehfooz hai.

blocks.prompt: Barium ions zehreele hain, phir bhi barium sulphate X-ray ke liye nigla jata hai. Yeh mehfooz kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Barium sulphate intehai kam ghulta hai (9.43 x 10^-7 mol fi 100 g paani), is liye taqreeban koi barium ion ghul kar jazb nahi hota; yeh bas aanton se guzar jata hai.

items: Mg(OH)2 aur CaCO3 antacids; haddiyon ke liye calcium supplements.
MgSO4 (Epsom salts) julaab; na ghulne wala BaSO4 barium meals ke liye.
